prompts.medallion_light:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: one isolated production 2D game HUD sprite. Square PNG, requested final canvas 512 x 512 pixels. A single asset only, no sheet or layout.
Style: delicate watercolor and colored-pencil fairy-tale illustration, fine sepia outlines and subtle dry paper pigment texture inside painted shapes. Matte hand-painted finish, warm dusk palette. Absolutely no text, letters, logo, watermark, checkerboard painted into the image, 3D bevels, shiny photoreal metal, scenery, extra UI or decorative presentation background. Actual transparent RGBA outside the asset.
Primary request: a clean antique GOLD SUN medallion FRAME ONLY, absolutely no portrait and no filled center. It will be used at 60 px diameter, so simplicity is critical. Reference image 1 supplies only the overall storybook tone and restrained medallion language of the upper-left HUD; do not copy the characters or environment. Reference image 2 is the old HUD specifically to AVOID: it is too ornate; replace its filigree and crowns with plain elegant geometry.
Geometry, strict: exact centered front-facing circle, center at (256,256) in the requested 512px square. Main outer circle diameter about 470 px, cardinal diamond tips extend no farther than x/y=16 or496. Central opening is a perfectly circular fully TRANSPARENT hole, diameter 287 px (56% of canvas); nothing may cover the hole. Transparent outside the outer contour. Same hole will be used for the silver companion frame. Keep the face opening clean, not tinted or filled.
Design: an uncluttered matte antique gold annulus with very understated pigment, thin crisp inner and outer gold outline circles and quiet warm amber flat middle area. No deep dimensional bevel, no tiny engraving. Four SMALL simple diamond-shaped sun-ray ornaments at 12,3,6,9 o'clock aligned to the circle, exactly four; no crown, branches, foliage, gems, chains, rosettes, spikes or baroque scrollwork. Restrained short sun-ray marks on the lower part of the band only, extremely subtle. Balanced radial geometry, uniform circular width, calm negative space, clearly readable silhouette at 60px. The ring must feel simple rather than ornate. Keep all tiny shadowing within the band, nothing spilling into transparent hole. Return only this one gold ring with genuine alpha transparency.
